object.name: DroneCANNote
object.description: One note for the motors named in Mask (bit i = ESC index i), at Volume (0..11, 255 = the ESC's own), as the vendor message com.ninjapilot.esc.Note (20400). Every write broadcasts it. Four motors can hold four different pitches. Needs the NinjaPilot AM32 build; BeepCommand (DroneCANBeep) is the all-motors standard message.
